headline: Exchange Intake Falls To 568.5 Million Dollars From 721.3 Million, With OKX At 222.3 Million And Gate At 174.6 Million
narrative: Dollar intake across exchanges fell to 568.5 million from 721.3 million. Deribit accounts for 244.5 million of the current intake, OKX for 222.3 million, Gate for 174.6 million, and Binance for 108.0 million. The pipe sums the dollar value of assets arriving at exchanges over 24 hours, so the lower print means less net value moved onto exchanges than the prior reading, while those four venues are taking assets in.
author: jordan
